title: MCPRequest (JSON-RPC 2.0 envelope)
description: Validates every inbound MCP tool-call request before dispatch. Covers the JSON-RPC 2.0 envelope used by MCPRouterConnector. Distinct from schemas/mcp_request.json which covers the swarm agent envelope.

id.description: Request correlation ID. Must be a non-empty string or integer.

arguments.description: Arbitrary key-value arguments passed to the tool.
